editor.name: Unity
missing: Install Unity Hub (https://unity.com/download), sign in and activate the license, then install the editor with Installs → Install Editor — when installing, pick the Android Build Support module together with OpenJDK · Android SDK & NDK Tools.
If it is installed somewhere else, put the executable's path in the environment variable UNITY and run this again.

modules.name: Android Build Support
install: Close the editor, then Unity Hub → Installs → the gear on that version ({version}) → Add modules → pick Android Build Support together with OpenJDK · Android SDK & NDK Tools.
From a shell: "/Applications/Unity Hub.app/Contents/MacOS/Unity Hub" -- --headless install-modules --version {version} -m android android-sdk-ndk-tools android-open-jdk
It downloads several GB — run it only after the user says to, and wait until it finishes.
